arxiv-2104-12846.description: Abstract This paper presents a new Massive Open Online Course on Natural Language Processing, targeted at non-English speaking students. arxiv-2109-05858.description: Abstract The use of xenon-doped liquid argon (Xe-doped LAr) is a promising alternative for large-scale liquid argon Time Projection Chambers (LAr-TPC), since it mitigates the light suppression due to impurities and it also improves the photon-detection efficiency and uniformity with the distance.

arxiv-2303-16670.description: Abstract Ultrahigh-energy cosmic rays are almost exclusively detected through extensive air showers, which they initiate upon interaction with the atmosphere. arxiv-2510-25964.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ritesh Kanchi, Miya Natsuhara, Matt X. Wang. It is critically important to make computing courses accessible for disabled students.
